name: No_1
short_caption: The robot raises its right hand to perform a gentle shaking or waving motion, signaling a mild disagreement or 'no'.
movement_description: The robot lifts its right arm forward and outward, opening its hand with the palm facing forward. It executes a subtle, repetitive shaking or twisting motion of the hand and wrist to convey a 'no' or 'not quite' gesture. After a brief pause, the right arm is lowered smoothly back to the side of the body, returning the robot to its neutral resting posture.
safety_notes: The robot's right arm extends outward to its right side; keep the immediate right side of the robot's base clear of obstructions.
